works.title: God Bless The United States Of Aliens
works.summary: A nonhuman-voiced Catholic mass ceremony, an all-seeing eyewitness report, a prescient prophecy — a guest work in the Pavilion of Bosnia and Herzegovina.

works.title: Richiamare
works.summary: Carlo Sampaolesi's accordion improvisation on the worn memory of Bach's French Suite No. 3, released as a single-sided cassette on Canti Magnetici.
